boundaries.detail: Compiled recipes describe launch topology and checked manifest export, but an external trainer still executes the run.
The S3 Parquet lane depends on caller-managed credentials and does not store secrets inside the runtime.
The web_html lane is limited to public pages, domain allowlists, robots-aware fetch rules, and byte-capped extraction.
The repository proves a single-service runtime edge with supporting stores, not a hidden multi-cluster control plane.
Lifecycle, change-control, and supply-chain surfaces document review, retention, and removal intent, but external schedulers still carry out the physical delete or archive operation.
